'''Kutille''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] overseer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]] he was posted at an Imperial base at [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum's]] [[Eastern Ice Shelf]], where [[Supreme Commander]] [[Rans]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was held captive. When a Republic operative stormed the prison to rescue Rans and his subordinates, Kutille tried to oppose him but was killed in the fighting.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prison Overseer Kutille appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Ilum, who is the final boss of the quest "Prison Riot."
